findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_report_checkout · Private data: get_report_quote, create_report_checkout, get_report · Public sink: create_report_checkout · Destructive: get_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_report_checkout · Private data: get_report_quote, create_report_checkout, get_report · Public sink: create_report_checkout · Destructive: get_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
